channel.title: Sukrara for Mac
channel.description: Updates of Sukrara for Mac (the GitHub and Homebrew version).

item.title: Sukrara 0.14.0
item.description:
• The Android GitHub version updates itself (#188): once a day it looks for a new version and says so in a quiet notification (Update, Release notes), downloads it, checks it is the release's file signed with Sukrara's key, and installs it, never while an alert is showing or a very low is on; monitoring comes back by itself right after. Android asks once to allow installs from Sukrara. Install updates automatically (Settings › About › Updates, off) installs without a tap where Android allows it. The Google Play version keeps updating through Play. Updating to this version is still by hand; from then on Sukrara does it.
  • The Mac updates itself (GitHub and Homebrew version, #91): once a day it looks for a new version, signed by Sukrara and checked before it installs, and offers it in the menu bar panel; Install and Relaunch is one click. Settings › General › About has Check for Updates…, automatic checks (on) and automatic install (off). The App Store version keeps updating through the store. Updating to this version is still by hand (the dmg or brew upgrade); from then on Sukrara does it.
  • Do Not Disturb and Focus are respected by default (#184): the alert checklist says plainly whether Sukrara alerts in Do Not Disturb (Android) or during a Focus (Mac), with Let Sukrara through / Don't let Sukrara through (Android: Do Not Disturb access the first time, then the alarm channels' override; Mac: Time Sensitive), and home shows a neutral line while a mode keeps alerts quiet. Updating from 0.13.0: the alarm channels keep the override they have; the Mac's alerts stop being Time Sensitive until you let Sukrara through.
  • Sound while the phone is unlocked (Android, #183) is answered from a test alert: Test the sound, then I heard it / It only vibrated. The earlier answer is asked again.
  • Widgets and the card look like the earlier app again (#181): Android's widgets are drawn at the size the launcher really gives them and are never stretched or squashed, on the home screen and in the widget picker, in the wallpaper's colours. On Android and the Mac the rings show their number without "%", a fresh value has no "now", and the value has as many slots beside it as fit (up to four).
  • Android look (#181): the phone's own colours across the app, the dark theme included, the phone's round font in titles, and Material 3 Expressive motion.
  • Settings (Android, #181): a search result opens its page at the row it found and highlights it; the alert reliability checklist, the status lines and the dialogs use Android's own settings components; Sharing's rows have their icons; TalkBack says again what a tap on an action row does (copy, import, fix).
  • Sharing (#181): a follower whose invite the wearer never answers no longer waits forever: when the invite expires, Sukrara says Invite expired with Join with a new link (Android and Mac). The Mac's Find phones nearby works again after a follow ended.
  • Fixes (#181): Active now names the right reason when a Mute and carbs quiet the same alerts (Android and Mac); Add treatment opened from home no longer offers Open Sukrara; in Spanish the app says "hidratos" everywhere and "Glucosa baja / alta" for the alert groups.
  • Not a medical device: setup's Welcome and About in Settings say so, on Android and the Mac; the Mac's About also links the privacy policy.
